commands.command: git status --short && git diff -- build.py && rg -n "patch|region|history|markdown_blocks|render_block|guin-patch" build.py tests/test_s3.py
sed -n '1,320p' build.py && sed -n '560,930p' build.py && sed -n '1020,1090p' build.py && sed -n '1,410p' tests/test_s3.py
nl -ba build.py | sed -n '120,285p'; nl -ba build.py | sed -n '395,465p'; nl -ba build.py | sed -n '680,930p'; nl -ba build.py | sed -n '930,1090p'; nl -ba build.py | sed -n '1090,1205p'

nl -ba build.py | sed -n '300,400p'; nl -ba build.py | sed -n '465,560p'; rg -n "def parse_written|def parse_post|def parse_links|def fail" build.py; git diff --no-index /dev/null build.py | sed -n '1,260p'
ls -ld /tmp /var/tmp /usr/tmp .; find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -perm -u+w -print | head -20; git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed -n '1,80p'

python3 -c 'import importlib.util; from pathlib import Path; s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("build","build.py"); b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(b); p=b.Post(Path("post.md"),"post",{"written":"2024-02-03T04:05:06Z","type":"short"},"old"); q=b.Patch(Path("content/patches/p.json"),"p","post","2024-02-04T00:00:00Z","why","replace","old","first paragraph\\n\\nsecond paragraph"); st=b.PatchState(p); st.apply(q); body,regs=st.regions_and_marked_body(); print(repr(body)); print([(r.region_id,r.deleted,[x.patch_id for x in r.history]) for r in regs]); out,_=b.render_body(st.body,Path("content"),Path("post.md"),"",patch_state=st); print(out); print("spans",out.count("class=\\"patch-region\\""),"history",out.count("class=\\"patch-history\\""))'

python3 -c 'import importlib.util; from pathlib import Path; spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("build", "build.py"); b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(b); p=b.Post(Path("post.md"), "post", {"written":"2024-02-03T04:05:06Z", "type":"short"}, "old"); q=b.Patch(Path("content/patches/p.json"), "p", "post", "2024-02-04T00:00:00Z", "why", "replace", "old", "first paragraph\n\nsecond paragraph"); st=b.PatchState(p); st.apply(q); body, regs=st.regions_and_marked_body(); print(repr(body)); print([(r.region_id, r.deleted, [x.patch_id for x in r.history]) for r in regs]); out,_=b.render_body(st.body, Path("content"), Path("post.md"), "", patch_state=st); print(out); print("spans", out.count("class=\\\"patch-region\\\""), "history", out.count("class=\\\"patch-history\\\""))'

python3 -c 'import importlib.util,sys; from pathlib import Path; spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("build", "build.py"); b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[spec.name]=b; spec.loader.exec_module(b); p=b.Post(Path("post.md"), "post", {"written":"2024-02-03T04:05:06Z", "type":"short"}, "old"); q=b.Patch(Path("content/patches/p.json"), "p", "post", "2024-02-04T00:00:00Z", "why", "replace", "old", "first paragraph\n\nsecond paragraph"); st=b.PatchState(p); st.apply(q); body, regs=st.regions_and_marked_body(); print(repr(body)); print([(r.region_id, r.deleted, [x.patch_id for x in r.history]) for r in regs]); out,_=b.render_body(st.body, Path("content"), Path("post.md"), "", patch_state=st); print(out); print("spans", out.count("class=\\\"patch-region\\\""), "history", out.count("class=\\\"patch-history\\\""))'

find content -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort | sed -n '1,100p'; find docs/p -maxdepth 1 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort | sed -n '1,100p'; rg -n "patch-region|patch-data|패치 보기" docs -g '*.html' | head -40
